BURNINGMOD-FIRE_ORB.title: Fire Orb
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_ORB.description: At the end of your turn, deal damage to a random enemy and apply [gold]Burn[/gold]. Evoke: Deal more damage and apply more [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_ORB.smartDescription:
At the end of your turn, deal {Passive} damage to a random enemy. Apply {Passive} [gold]Burn[/gold] to that enemy.
Evoke: Deal {Evoke} damage and apply {Evoke} [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-INFERNO_ORB.title: Inferno Orb
BURNINGMOD-INFERNO_ORB.description: Counts as a [gold]Fire Orb[/gold]. Passive: Deal 4 damage and apply 4 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. Evoke: ALL enemies lose HP equal to their [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks.
BURNINGMOD-INFERNO_ORB.smartDescription:
Counts as a [gold]Fire Orb[/gold].
Passive: Deal {Passive} damage and apply {Passive} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Evoke: ALL enemies take unblockable damage equal to their [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks.
